name: Tsukigata Rio
source:
The national champion of Magic Monsters.
Although she is a young girl—roughly the same age as Itsuki and his friends—her overwhelming prowess is enough to leave even adults awestruck.
However, she rarely speaks about herself; her background and origins remain a complete mystery.
She maintains a consistently cool demeanor and displays an uncompromising determination to win.
Her favorite subject is arithmetic.
